title: Screen Translator Internal Inventory
description: The Screen Translator's internal inventory. It lists every visual unit detected in the legacy system, with a stable identity and traceability back to the source code. Saved to _reversa_sdd/screens/inventory.json. Overwritten on every run.

sourcePlatform.description: The slug of the detected source platform (e.g. cobol-ansi-tui, delphi-vcl, asp-classic, android-xml, ios-xib).

screens.description: The list of screens detected in the legacy system.

id.description: A unique, stable identifier within this inventory (e.g. SCR-0001).

canonicalName.description: The screen's canonical name, as used in target_screens.md.

file.description: The relative path of the legacy file.

line.description: The line in the file, where applicable.

paragraph.description: The name of the COBOL paragraph, the Delphi/VB6 form, the Android Activity, etc.

kind.description: The screen's structural type. Use 'raw' when no adapter covers the type.

isCritical.description: Marks critical vs. auxiliary screens (fed by reversa-detective when available). In hybrid mode, critical screens tend to go literal.

matchesUiInventory.description: true if the screen appears in _reversa_sdd/ui/inventory.md.

uiInventoryRef.description: The corresponding line or anchor in _reversa_sdd/ui/inventory.md.

transitions.description: The next screens or the events triggered from this one.

i18n.description: When the screen has an external string catalog.

skipped.description: When the legacy system has no UI, this field is filled in and screens[] stays empty.

divergenceFromUiInventory.description: A comparison against _reversa_sdd/ui/inventory.md. If divergencePercent > 10, the agent stops and asks for a review (FR-05).
